generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
Bidders shall ensure upload of relevant document certifying his/her status as Scheduled Caste/ Scheduled Tribe/other reserved category as prescribed in the tender document.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
Detailed terms and conditions are mentioned in the tender Document.

The intending Bidder as a prime contractor should have satisfactorily completed at least one similar work of Annual Maintenance Contract(AMC) for Motorola make VHF Wireless sets not less than Rs. 1.60 lakh in the last five years (i.e. 2021-22, 2022-23, 2023-24, 2024-25 and 2025-26) in any power plants or process/Major industries or any reputed organizations. As a proof, the bidder shall furnish Work Order and related Work Done certificate/Work completion certificate/MOM/ Service Reports issued by a competent authority. (Work done of previous year shall be given weight of 10% per year to bring them to the present price level of the financial year FY-2026-27).

technicalCriterionList.description: The intending bidder shall be the Original Equipment Manufacturer (OEM) or an authorized dealer/service provider for Motorola make VHF wireless sets. As a proof, the bidder shall submit valid authorization documents

The intending Bidder in his name should have achieved an average annual financial turnover of Rs. 3.20 Lakhs in any two years during the last five financial years (i.e. 2021-22, 2022-23, 2023-24, 2024-25 and 2025-26).As a proof, the bidder should upload a turnover certificate or Profit & Loss account duly certified by a Chartered Accountant. (Financial turnover of previous year shall be given weight of 10% per year to bring them to the present price level of financial year 2026-27)
